Outstanding service! From our decision to choose Greenultimate for solar to the completion of the installed product, the team at Greenultimate has been exceptional. They maintained communication every step of the process, ensuring we were always informed. Moreover, the speed from signing up to installation and activation of the panels was remarkable. After looking into it real hard, I decided to go with Greenultimate solar for my solar setup. This customer service guy Arif, along with Fahad and Hamza from the sales team, really helped me out a lot. Alex , the guy who put in the panels did a good job, even when things got tough. We went for a 50kW system on our farm with these smart Canadian Solar panels that have TS4 Long String Optimisers, supposed to be real good.At first, I picked Shine for boost cause they had cheap prices, but their guys showed up without appointment outta nowhere with old busted panels with tiny cracks. I said no and asked them leave I canceled order said thanks and got my money back. Then I got in touch with Arif at Greenultimate. He walked me through everything and set up face to face meetings with his sales team. Plus he said I didn't have to pay upfront  which made me feel more comfortable. The whole job was done in two weeks, and Alex did it real well.The paperwork went smooth, and I got a smart meter in four weeks. Since then my electricity bill is been around $200 thanks to solar power. I'm really happy with Greenultimate Solar. They are professional, their prices are fair and they have cut down my bills a lot. Big thanks to Greenultimate Solar for their great service.

I just received my first bill and I am extremely happy because I saved more than 90% on it. The customer service manager, Arif, and his sales team were very helpful. Arif explained everything to me in a clear manner and they installed a system that met my specific needs. They used Canadian Solar panels and a Goodwee hybrid inverter, which allows for future battery connection if I decide to add one later on. The installer, Sam, was professional, friendly, and honest. His team also cleaned up everything after the installation. The entire process, from signing the paperwork to completing the installation, only took one week. So far, I am very satisfied with the service and I have already recommended Arif and Greenultimate to my family and friends.I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a similar service.

During the sales process, we often felt pressured to make an appointment. The solar engineer, explained the panels and inverter to be used, but he also seemed very pushy and eager to make the sale before the end of the financial year. He did not clearly explain the charges for the finance being used or the company he applied for the finance with, which was only provided after the fact.After being away for a few weeks, we contacted them to find out when installation would take place. He responded via email that it would be starting in the next week. However, on a Sunday morning, the installers showed up without any prior notice. Unfortunately, we were not at home at the time. The installer asked where we wanted the panels, and we directed them to the location on the plan. However, the installer had a different idea, which caused us to ask them to leave until we could speak with our original solar engineer. Despite sending multiple emails and leaving messages, we received no response from him.Due to the lack of customer support and organisation, we ultimately decided to cancel our order and finance. Since then, we have received several other quotes from local installers, and they are approximately $7,000 cheaper than GreenUltimate.

The sales quoting process was good and they answered our many questions. Thanks to this site - Solar Quotes we were able to be better informed and less prone to “sales talk”.The installation was done quickly and efficiently and caused no disruption to us.The customer service has been good we have contacted them with questions about the App and the connection. Unfortunately it is difficult to determine if it is our energy supplier or the solar supplier but 5 weeks on we are no closer to getting connected to the grid. Each keep blaming the other for the delay.
